annotations.title: Get a temporary attachment download URL

description: Resolve a stored discussion attachment to a ten-minute signed download URL. Requires read permission and the attachment must belong to the selected finding and message. Does not download bytes or forward the Odin key to storage. Treat the returned signed URL as a temporary secret.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

url.description: Exact private attachment URL from this message's attachments array.

name: get_finding_attachment_url
title: Get a temporary attachment download URL
